answer: Each pigment-market AI agent vertex needs 10 day-bound endorsement units for daily pay. A fixed sponsor roster has 100 units/day total. Ledger validators enforce trust-graph bridge capacities, flow conservation and one terminal key per unit; failed checks deny pay. Thus n keys consume 10n units, so at most ten qualify.
